intro: Beside the PC that won't turn off, a scientist is engrossed in complex documents.
introDialogue: Oh? A visitor in a place like this... Perfect timing! This PC is still connected to the legacy network, meaning we can recover useful data and items. Shall we use it?
speaker: Scientist
title: Unending PC
description: An abandoned PC still holding trade candidates, vitamins, item records, and TM logs.
query: Which box log would you like to open?

1.label: Open Box 1
1.tooltip: (+) Trade for one of four candidate Pokemon
1.tradeOptionsPrompt: Choose a trade candidate. Each candidate has one bonus: ability, egg move, passive, or 6V.
1.selectedDialogue: A network trade! According to my analysis, some highly promising candidates are detected.

2.label: Open vitamin box
2.tooltip: (+) Choose one of five vitamins from the reward screen
2.selectedDialogue: Starting recovery of vitamin storage logs. They should be useful for boosting your stats.

3.label: Take an item
3.tooltip: (+) Choose Multi Lens, Leftovers, Shell Bell, or Master Ball
3.selectedDialogue: These are data logs of valuable battle items. Materializing them now.

4.label: Open TM log
4.tooltip: (+) Choose one of five Great-or-better TMs
4.selectedDialogue: Reconstructing the TM transfer logs. I hope this enhances your party's capabilities.

outro: Data transfer complete. I will continue my research now. Good luck!
